messages:
Mira: heads-up 10m — onboarding owner sync job mis-applied owners when contact.owner_email was null.
Jon: saw a small spike in unowned accounts, any customer impact?
Mira: 47 accounts ended up with owner=null, 6 are in their first 14d (should've been assigned).
Elena: root cause? recent change to owner resolution in onboarding lambda?
Jon: yep commit 9f2a changed fallback from last_known_owner -> null in the mapper.
ops-bot: alert CREATED: OWNER_SYNC_REGRESSION #3456789012 severity=medium
Mira: plan: 1) roll back mapper to fallback to last_known_owner 2) backfill owners for 47 accounts using last_known_owner 3) trigger targeted onboarding nudges for 6 trial accounts 4) add CI check.
Elena: I'll open PR for rollback + unit test for fallback behavior.
Jon: exporting affected accounts: `select account_id from accounts where owner is null and created_at > '2025-06-01' and env='prod' limit 100` -> /tmp/owner_backfill_345678.csv
ops-bot: run queued: backfill-job-345678 (dry-run).
Mira: dry-run shows 47 updates, no conflicts. scheduling prod backfill in 15m, will DM AMs for the 6 trial accounts.
AM-bot: DMs sent to account owners for 6 trials with template: "We detected missing owner on onboarding — we've restored the Owner and queued a welcome check-in. Reply to opt out."
Elena: PR merged and deployed, added contract test asserting fallback != null when last_known_owner exists.
Mira: prod backfill executed: 47 owners restored, 6 trial nudges queued. logging postmortem in #customer-success-postmortems.
Jon: follow-up: add an alert for owner_null_rate > 0.1% and mark owner-resolution code as safety-critical.
Mira: agreed. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
